steps.title: Define Project Architecture and Meta
steps.description: Initialize app metadata and setup offline calculation structure for ModernCalc.

steps.title: Create Responsive HTML Skeleton
steps.description: Structure the calculator card, display panels, keypad, scientific drawer, and history drawer.

steps.title: Configure Modern Visual Themes & Typography
steps.description: Load Tailwind CSS v4 and establish theme variables, glassmorphic styling, and fluid display sizing.

steps.title: Design Interactive Display & Mode Switcher
steps.description: Build high-visibility display with secondary expression tracker, memory indicators, and mode toggles.

steps.title: Implement Web Audio Feedback Engine
steps.description: Synthesize subtle, zero-dependency audio click feedback for tactile keypad responsiveness.

steps.title: Develop Core Arithmetic Calculation Engine
steps.description: Implement precision-safe math operations, bracket precedence, percentages, and floating-point safeguards.

steps.title: Add Scientific Math Functions
steps.description: Implement trigonometry, logarithmic, exponential, powers, roots, and mathematical constants.

steps.title: Implement Memory Registers
steps.description: Add memory clear (MC), recall (MR), add (M+), and subtract (M-) functionality with visual badge.

steps.title: Build Calculation History System
steps.description: Implement persistent session history log with recall-to-display and clear actions.

steps.title: Create Integrated Unit Converter
steps.description: Add quick switcher for unit conversions including Length, Temperature, Mass, and Data storage.

steps.title: Configure Keyboard Shortcuts & Input Sanitization
steps.description: Map standard physical keyboard keys, numpad, escape, backspace, and brackets to calculator actions.

steps.title: Polish Transitions, Ripple Effects, and Clipboard Support
steps.description: Add tactile button animations, copy-to-clipboard toast notifications, and display shrink-to-fit.

steps.title: Building moderncalc
steps.description: Finalize verification of responsive layouts, offline accuracy, and visual aesthetics.
